verdict.rationale: Maritime documents its own RESTful API, SDKs, a Files API, webhooks, and an agent-operable CLI that uses the same Bearer token as the API, so broad programmatic control exists. Nothing in the evidence claims parity with the UI. Several workflows are described only in the UI (Computers keys created in Settings, live build logs on the agent page, customizing templates from the agent page), and no OpenAPI spec was found to confirm coverage. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a published OpenAPI or full endpoint reference, documented API equivalents for UI-only flows (scoped Computers keys, build-log streaming, template customization, GitHub App connection), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
